title: Mastery of Hate
summary: Clear the ferans, then rotate tanks to control the Master of Hate's growing damage.
overview: Clear the ferans, then rotate tanks to control the Master of Hate's growing damage.

phases.label: Feran mothers
phases.description: Defeat the six mothers while controlling the direpups.

phases.label: Master of Hate
phases.description: Rotate the top-threat tank to reset the growing maximum hit.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Kill the feran mothers while controlling the direpups they produce.
When the master activates, rotate the top-threat tank deliberately.
His maximum hit rises while one tank remains on top; a detected tank change resets that escalation.

notes: Reviewed quest source; behavior, balance, spawns and completion have not been verified in a live instance.
This document applies to instance version 2.
